# Priced Right Heating & Cooling

> > Professional HVAC services including heating, cooling, and heat pump repair, installation, and maintenance serving Lenexa, Overland Park, Shawnee, Olathe, and Johnson County, Kansas.

Priced Right Heating & Cooling is a locally-owned HVAC contractor specializing in residential heating and air conditioning services throughout the Kansas City metro area. The company offers 24/7 emergency repairs, Energy Star-certified installations featuring Trane systems, NATE-certified technicians, and flexible financing options through Synchrony Bank.

- Johnson County service area
- Lenexa, Overland Park, Shawnee, Olathe locations
